payload.note: The complete public order-lambda generator gives a nonzero rank-four neutral and stationary correction Z^-1[K_+,P0] to the standard finite one-particle projector. Ghost parity sends it to the linearly independent Z branch. The Eq. (19) charge formula still holds with Q=0, but the whole neutral pushforward is not ghost even; its canonical ghost-odd remainder is orthogonal but has relative norm -7/288 rather than zero, so the published weak-ghost-symmetry mechanism fails on this branch. The minimal exact finite repair averages the two orbit branches and exponentiates to a neutral, stationary, ghost-even projector, but that conjugate branch is not supplied by the public Rt map. Evidence: REVERSE_PHYSICS_BT_COVARIANT_GHOST_PARITY_BRANCH_OBSTRUCTION_V1.
